subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly by making explicit `heartbeat.session` win over event-provided wake keys while preserving the documented `session.dmScope=main` default, or should Telegram DM isolation defaults change too?
rationale: Current source proves the heartbeat precedence bug, but changing default DM isolation is compatibility-sensitive and needs maintainer product intent.

options.title: Narrow heartbeat precedence fix
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` take precedence over forced wake session keys, add regression coverage, and leave default DM sharing unchanged unless already configured otherwise.

options.title: Change DM isolation default
options.body: Move Telegram or global DM defaults toward per-channel isolation, with migration/docs because existing users may rely on shared main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to live repro first
options.body: Require fresh live Telegram plus heartbeat proof before choosing the permanent routing contract, leaving the issue open with the linked PR as candidate context.

recommendation.title: Narrow heartbeat precedence fix
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` take precedence over forced wake session keys, add regression coverage, and leave default DM sharing unchanged unless already configured otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent related event-routing fix in current history and is best positioned to decide the compatibility boundary.
